actualCoverage.readMethod: Read all source blocks 0-60 and local Guiyou chapter 27 lines 5045-5231. Independently read every saved Chinese/Japanese pair in ranges 0-14,15-34,35-60, title and all eleven notes. Reread each changed sentence.

changes.before: 東へ回ったら、もういないのよ。
changes.after: あの子は東へ回って、そのまま見えなくなったのよ。
changes.reason: Keep Daiyu as the person supposedly turning east in Baochai fabricated account; avoid ambiguous shift to the speaker.

changes.before: 人を選ばないどころか、この娘をよそへ回していたのね。
changes.after: 人を選んでくれないばかりか、この娘をよそへ回していたのね。
changes.reason: Use additive complaint, not a Japanese reversal construction.

changes.before: 腰をかがめたり、手を合わせたりして詫びていた。
changes.after: 腰をかがめ、両手を組み合わせて礼をしながら詫びていた。
changes.reason: Represent 作揖 as joined-hand bow rather than a prayer-like gesture.

changes.before: もとより清い身で来たのなら、
changes.after: もとより清い身で来たもの、
changes.reason: Original purity is asserted, not conditional.

changes.before: 今、おまえが死ねば、私が拾い葬ってやる。
changes.after: 今、死んだおまえを、私が拾い葬ってやる。
changes.reason: 花 is already fallen/dead now; preserve actual burial rather than a hypothetical future death.

checkedAndRetained: Baochai inner judgments remain her thoughts, not narrator claims; eavesdropping, false Daiyu story and consequent misunderstanding retain sequence.
Four-month twenty-sixth day and Wei time, second watch versus Guiyou third watch, twelve performers and duplicate child names retained with source notes.
160 silver liang embroidery payment versus reference 120, weighing before recipient, pouch and all messenger stages.
Layered message across four or five households retains labels and uncertainty rather than inventing identities; two pills and two-day delay preserved.
Hongyu age seventeen, naming taboo and mother/daughter generation joke; ambiguous 肯跟 remains annotated.
Tanchun savings ten-plus strings, five hundred cash and one cart, handmade objects and footwear, concubine-origin conflict retained as character speech.
All 26 葬花吟 blocks checked line by line, including flower/bird/person address, seasons and 360 days, present burial and uncertain future burial.
No Guiyou-only final prose or commentary imported.

guiyouComparison.decisions: Verified existing notes on second/third watch, duplicate child names, 160/120 liang, 肯跟/上月, one/two carts, poem opening and added ending. Current source retained; authenticity not used to exclude candidates.

limitations: Source variants remain unresolved and annotated; no Chinese/traditional Chinese/English changes.
